tools.name: get_empty_leg
tools.description: Re-read one live empty leg by the `ref` a search returned, priced for the party size. Says it is no longer available once booked, withdrawn or flown.

tools.name: booking_handoff
tools.description: Return the altivojets.com page where the traveller reviews an empty leg and sends the booking request themselves. Read-only: creates no booking, hold or payment and sends no details to Altivo.

tools.name: get_charter_estimate
tools.description: Indicative full-charter price by aircraft size, one-way or return, in the local currency of the departure market: price range before taxes, estimated taxes, an all-in range, flight time and fuel stops, with the recommended size. tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: Popular private jet routes by market, ordered by search demand, each with a from price, typical aircraft, flight time, live empty legs on the route and its altivojets.com guide page.

tools.name: list_aircraft
tools.description: Aircraft sizes (turboprops to heavy jets and helicopters) with seats, range, the market's indicative hourly rate and the models most flown there by licensed operators.

tools.name: find_operators
tools.description: Licensed charter operators from the regulators' published lists, by market, base city or aircraft size: name, base city, licence type, fleet size and models, and the profile page. For trips, use request_quote; the desk sources and books through these operators.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Countries Altivo Jets serves, each with its currency, home aviation regulator and licence, and the local site and empty legs page.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send the traveller's trip and contact details to the Altivo Jets desk, for a full charter or a specific empty leg (empty_leg_ref). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: booking_handoff · Private data: list_routes, request_quote · Public sink: request_quote · Destructive: search_empty_legs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: booking_handoff · Private data: list_routes, request_quote · Public sink: request_quote · Destructive: search_empty_legs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
